data.note: Yahoo 5-minute data is ~15 min delayed and covers ~60 sessions; log in to FYERS to backfill ~1 year.

rules.square_off: 15:00 for F&O stocks (FYERS MIS cut-off 15:05), 15:15 others
rules.fills: next bar open; stop orders at the level or the open if it gapped
rules.costs: FYERS intraday brokerage, STT 0.025% sell, stamp 0.003% buy, NSE + SEBI fees, GST, slippage

sebi.source: SEBI, Analysis of Intraday Trading by Individuals in Equity Cash Segment (July 2024)
points: 71% of individual intraday traders made net losses in FY23 (65% in FY19).
80% of those making more than 500 trades a year lost money.
Trading costs made loss-makers' losses 57% larger and took 19% of profit-makers' profits.
In F&O, 93% of individual traders lost money in FY22-FY24 (SEBI, Sep 2024).

strategies.name: Gap-and-go / gap fade
strategies.description: Big opening gaps: follow them when there is news (results) and heavy volume, fade them when there is no news and the gap fails in the first 15 minutes.

strategies.name: Supertrend (10, 3) on 5-min
strategies.description: Follow each Supertrend flip within the day. An ATR trailing stop - trend following with lots of whipsaw.

strategies.name: VWAP trend
strategies.description: Long above VWAP, short below (with a small band), flipping as price crosses. One working paper on QQQ; each flip costs ~0.1-0.2% here.

strategies.name: Intraday momentum (morning predicts close)
strategies.description: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018, JFE): the move from yesterday's close to 09:45 predicts the last half hour. Enter 14:30, exit 15:00. Tiny edge per trade - costs decide.

strategies.name: VWAP pullback on trend days
strategies.description: After a strong first hour, buy the first dip to VWAP that closes back above it (mirror for down days).

strategies.name: Opening range breakout (15-min)
strategies.description: Break of the 09:15-09:30 high or low (OCO stop orders), stop at the other side of the range, target twice the risk. The most popular intraday setup; US studies are positive before costs, independent replications find roughly zero after costs.

strategies.name: Closing-hour trend
strategies.description: At 14:05, buy stocks up 1%+ near their day high and above VWAP (mirror for losers), exit at the square-off.

strategies.name: Narrow CPR breakout
strategies.description: Popular in India: on narrow Central Pivot Range days, trade the side the market opens and holds (first 15 minutes), stop at the other side of the CPR, target R1/S1. No peer-reviewed evidence.

strategies.name: ORB-5 'stocks in play'
strategies.description: Zarattini, Barbon & Aziz (2024): only stocks with unusual early volume; trade the direction of the first 5-minute candle, tight stop (10% of daily ATR), hold to the close.
